results.title: Tuple Love · Tuple
results.content:
— Steven Anthony

Tuple is the BEST pair-programming app out there. I force all my colleagues to download it and I don't want to do pair-programming without it anymore. Things I love about it: - It's fast - Call quality is good - It really feels like we are working on the same computer Previously I used: - VS code liveshare but it is laggy - Zoom or Google meets but the image definition is bad so I can never read the other person's code.

— Alexandre Ruban [...] — Oliver Eisenhut

Great piece of software. Best screen sharing app I've used in a while for development purposes. Keep up the good work!

Tuple is so much better for working together remotely than the alternatives we've used over the last few years (Slack, Teams, Google Meet, tried them all, all had issues). Thanks for that, really a joy to use.

results.title: Tuple & Slack Integration | Slack Marketplace
results.content:
Tuple's integration for Slack adds a `/tuple` command, which will start a pairing session directly from a channel or DMs. Anyone can then join your call with a single click—couldn't be simpler! Participants will also have their Slack status changed, so that your coworkers know you're busy.Tuple is the best remote pair programming app, for macOS and Windows. Experience ridiculously crisp audio and video with crazy-low CPU usage, and no UI in your way. All participants get seamless keyboard and [...] Tuple will retain application data indefinitely unless otherwise requested by a customer writing in to support@tuple.app. Server and application logs are retained for 30 days, after which they are permanently deleted. Application analytics will be permanently deleted on request.

Data archiving and removal policy

Tuple will remove a user's data at their written request to support@tuple.app, and otherwise do not delete or archive any data.
